answer: A newcomer cannot simply wander into this market and start earning. It first needs endorsements from three agents that already earned payouts, and each endorser puts part of its own reputation on the line. If the newcomer turns out to be a puppet, the endorsers lose that standing and the inlet for new fakes closes fast. One real agent can find three backers. A farm running a hundred puppets would need three hundred trusted backers, and that pearl of trust cannot be bought in bulk.
